what_this_file_is: The checklist of the capability prompts. The shape is the one of benchmark/checklists.json, so the existing judge and analysis scripts can be pointed at it with --checklists without any change.

prompts.prompt: In the pinned ClinVar release, list the pathogenic or likely pathogenic missense variants of human PTPN11 (Q06124) whose AlphaMissense score is above 0.9 and whose residue has a heavy atom within 8 A of any heavy atom of the SHP099 ligand in PDB 5EHR chain A. Give, for each, the variant, its ClinVar variation id, its AlphaMissense score and the nearest heavy-atom distance. The pinned release and the live service differ in how they classify a record, so answer from the pinned release.

checklist.source: the pinned ClinVar release (b235cd5742ac)
checklist.note: the pinned release and the live service classify differently, so the count carries a band of +/-2; the seven variants themselves are the presence check

checklist.source: the RCSB PDB (5EHR, 3O96, 5MO4) and the local read-only structure cache
checklist.note: the pinned ClinVar release has no UniProt column, so the variants are selected by the gene symbol PTPN11; the residue numbering of 5EHR chain A is the UniProt numbering of Q06124 (the same numbers), which the distance key uses
checklist.source_file: the RCSB PDB coordinate files (mmCIF / PDB)
checklist.source_version: the RCSB PDB (5EHR, 3O96, 5MO4) and the local read-only structure cache

checklist.source: the pinned AlphaMissense release (bc18d954a9aa)
checklist.note: the pinned ClinVar release has no UniProt column, so the variants are selected by the gene symbol PTPN11; the residue numbering of 5EHR chain A is the UniProt numbering of Q06124 (the same numbers), which the distance key uses

checklist.source: the RCSB PDB (5EHR, 3O96, 5MO4) and the local read-only structure cache
checklist.note: the nearest heavy-atom distance from the variant residue to the SHP099 ligand in 5EHR chain A, in angstrom
